A total of eleven flights arriving and departing from Chennai airport has been cancelled due to cyclone Murasu on Monday (November 2, 2026).
In a statement, Airports Authority of India (AAI) said, flights to and from destinations including Vijayawada, Kadapa, Rajahmundry and Tiruchi will be cancelled.
These flights are scheduled from 12.30 p.m. to 10.10 p.m. on Monday (November 2, 2026). The flight numbers include: 6E7304, 6E7305, 6E7306, 6E7365, 6E7366, 6E7398, 6E7397, 6E7357, 6E7358, 6E7363 and 6E7364. AAI has asked air passengers to check with the airlines for further information.
